scope: visible repository training data and current production agent definitions only

visibleBaselineScores.reason: No approved behavioral runner or externally signed evaluator evidence was available. Structural validation is not a behavioral score.

selfTestEvidence.reason: No role-execution self-test runner or signed event log was present in the bounded assignment.

coverageGapAnalysis.baselineGap: No required role-responsibility/reliability matrix assigns every applicable reliability dimension to an owner and evidence source.

Exact-schema policy exists at project level, but current role instructions do not consistently bind schema, credential type, resource grounding, deterministic validation, and success guards across planning, contracts, implementation, and review.
Current role instructions do not explicitly require stable item identity, operation-specific idempotency, atomic deduplication, duplicate/replay tests, or provider concurrency limits.
Current role instructions do not allocate retry eligibility, bounded backoff/jitter, retry exhaustion, distinct success/error paths, or exact version-sensitive Error Trigger semantics.
Current role instructions do not require independent postcondition oracles, side-effect state machines, or reconciliation before replay after partial or uncertain commits.

Secret handling is strong, but data classification, structured redacted telemetry, retention, alert deduplication/rate limits, handler recursion, and handler-failure tests are not systematically assigned.
The tuner protects private-suite separation but does not explicitly distinguish static coverage from behavioral scoring across each reliability dimension.

limitations: The baseline snapshot is not externally attested.
No visible behavioral cases were executed.
No external-validation, blind-holdout, signed-ledger, or trusted-integrator evidence is included.
No score is inferred from keyword presence or structural validation.
